headline: BAILEY 🏦 Says REGULATING 🤖 AI Is NOT 🚫 The RIGHT 🛤️ PLACE To START
text:
BANK 🏦 OF 🏛️ ENGLAND Governor 🍆 Andrew 🍑 BAILEY 🐺 says REGULATING 🤖 AI is NOT 🚫 the right 🛤️ place to START 🏁 but instead we NEED 🧪 rigorous 🧪 TESTING 🧪 and SAFEGUARDS 🛡️ to CONTAIN 🧯 RISK ⚠️ in his first ever 📝 SUBSTACK 🖋️ article that dropped 🌙 like a THIRSTY 💧 late night 📱 rant!! The risks around 🧠 AI are REAL 🔥 and increasingly SIGNIFICANT 📈 he wrote while stroking 👐 the idea that DEVELOPMENT 🚀 should NOT ❌ be HALTED 🛑 or PROHIBITED 🚫 because the BENEFITS 🏆 are IMMENSE 🌟 on the CONTRARY 🗣️ there must be a SYSTEM 🛠️ for INTERVENTION ✋ and to ESTABLISH 📏 boundaries 🧱 in which AI operates 🌀 so we don't get LOST 🌀 in the LOOP 🔄!!

The DEBATE 🗣️ about potential RISKS ⚠️ surrounding the RAPID ⚡ development of AI and what it MEANS ❓ for HUMANITY 👥 has INTENSIFIED 🔥 in recent WEEKS 📅 with bosses 🧑‍💼 of leading AI FIRMS 🏢 like ANTHROPIC 🐱 and OPENAI 🔓 calling for a SLOWDOWN 🐢 and an INTERNATIONALLY 🌍 COORDINATED 🤝 approach to ASSESSING 📊 risks and putting SAFEGUARDS 🛡️ in PLACE 📍!! OpenAI recently ANNOUNCED 📢 that it would NOT ❌ release its LATEST 🆕 AI MODEL 🧠 due to SAFETY 🛡️ concerns which left everyone DRIPPING 💦 with anticipation 😮 but the idea of a SLOWDOWN 🐢 has been REJECTED ❌ by the likes of PRESIDENT 🇺🇸 Donald 🧔 Trump who said the US is LEADING 🏆 the AI RACE 🏎️ ahead of CHINA 🇨🇳 and frankly he wants to KEEP 🛡️ it that way because whoever WINS 🏅 AI wins it ALL 🏆!!

But on TUESDAY 📅 after HOSTING 🏠 a meeting with BOSSES 🧑‍💼 from tech FIRMS 🏢 including OPENAI 🔓 ANTHROPIC 🐱 NVIDIA 💻 SPACEX 🚀 META 👁️ and GOOGLE 🔎 Trump said the executives had SIGNED ✍️ a morally BINDING 📜 document that would serve as a FORM 🧾 of PROTECTION 🛡️ from AI's potential RISKS ⚠️ under the AGREEMENT 🤝 the companies are RESPONSIBLE 🧾 for ensuring the SAFETY 🛡️ of their own TECHNOLOGY 🛠️ which feels like they're EDGING 🖐️ right up to the CLIMAX 🌋 of self regulation without anyone getting too RAILED 💦 yet!! In the UK 🇬🇧 Bailey 🐺 said important WORK 🛠️ was UNDERWAY 🚧 in TESTING 🧪 AI and the UK has SET 🏗️ up the AI SECURITY 🛡️ INSTITUTE 🏛️ which he said should HELP 🤝 form part of a SET 📋 of STANDARDS 📏 but the PACE 🏃 of PROGRESS 📈 must ACCELERATE 🏎️ though he added we should PROCEED 🚶 with a degree of HUMILITY 🙇!!

He said with TESTING 🧪 there will be FAILURES ❌ and MODELS 🧠 will BEHAVE 😶‍🌫️ UNEXPECTEDLY 😲 but that is NOT ❌ evidence that TESTING 🧪 has FAILED ❌ rather it is EVIDENCE 📜 of why TESTING 🧪 is NECESSARY 🛠️ and Bailey 🐺 specifically HIGHLIGHTED 🔦 so called FRONTIER 🏔️ AI which are highly ADVANCED 🚀 self learning SYSTEMS 🖥️ that without an effective way to INTERVENE ✋ risk becoming a CLOSED 🔒 LOOP 🔄 in which the MODEL 🧠 progressively GOVERNS 👑 itself which sounds like the ultimate DOMINATION 🐺 fantasy gone wrong if we don't get our SAFEGUARDS 🛡️ in place FAST 🏃!! Testing should NOT ❌ be seen as an ALTERNATIVE 🔄 to future REGULATION 📜 over time a more FORMAL 📋 regulatory FRAMEWORK 🏗️ might EMERGE 🌱 but REGULATION 📜 is NOT ❌ in my VIEW 👀 the right place to START 🏁 he concluded while the whole TECH 🧪 world stays DOWN BAD 😩 waiting for the next BIG 💥 move!!
